limitations: healthy reference compatible candidate labels, not proof of nonmalignant identity
unassigned cells retained in QC records, excluded from subtype pseudobulks
fixed-RNA background means surfactant RNA alone cannot assign epithelial identity
fractions concern recovered assayed cells, not tissue abundance
histology labels come from deposition; no inferred normal-to-cancer lineage
release_decision: Coherent broad multi-marker support in each histology; release candidate-compartment analysis with confidence selection and cross-lineage RNA limitations. No relabelling, threshold change, malignant/KAC assignment or all-tissue source claim.
source_attribution_limit: Unassigned finest labels carry median 52-72% of observed IL1B counts by histology.
reviewer: assistant manual inspection of full-cohort marker and patient-retention tables before paired effect interpretation
